Here is a simple footnote[^1]. With some additional text after it.

A footnote can also have a name[^note] and be referenced twice[^1].

A reference with no definition[^missing] stays as written, and so does one in code: `[^1]`.

[^1]: My reference.
[^note]: Every new line should be prefixed with 2 spaces.
    This allows you to have a footnote with multiple lines.
[^unused]: Nothing refers to this one, so it is not shown.
